sn35.146:1.1: desessāmi kammanirodhaṁ → desissāmi kammanirodhañca (bj, sya-all); desissāmi kammanirodham (pts)
sn35.146:1.3: purāṇakammaṁ cakkhu → purāṇaṁ kammaṁ cakkhuṁ (bj) | katamañca → katamam (pts) | kammaṁ → kāyakammaṁ vācākammaṁ manokammaṁ (bj: sīmu, sī.pavi)
sn35.146:1.4: purāṇakammaṁ → purāṇaṁ kammaṁ (bj) | cakkhu → cakkhuṁ (sya-all, pts)
sn35.146:1.12: kāyakammavacīkammamanokammassa → kāyakammaṁ vacīkammaṁ manokammassa (sya-all) | kāyakammavacīkammamanokammassa → kataṁ kho mayā (bj: syā)
sn35.146:1.18: purāṇakammaṁ → purāṇaṁ kammaṁ (bj) | navakammaṁ → navaṁ kammaṁ (bj)
sn35.146:1.19: kho → vo (bj) | vo taṁ → kho (sya-all) | mayā → kataṁ kho mayā (bj: syā)
